subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should OpenClaw accept operation-aware delivery resolution plus QQBot READY/RESUMED pending-delivery drains as the permanent fix for the linked QQBot reconnect outbound-loss issue?
rationale: The implementation looks coherent, but it deliberately changes compatibility-sensitive plugin resolution and queued-message replay timing across delivery paths, which needs maintainer ownership rather than automated approval.

options.title: Accept resolver and drain design
options.body: Accept the compatibility tradeoff as the intended fix and proceed after refreshing the branch against current main.

options.title: Require a narrower compatibility variant
options.body: Ask for a version that bypasses only the proven QQBot/setup-shell failure cases while preserving more existing resolver selection behavior.

options.title: Pause for a broader channel capability contract
options.body: Keep this PR open or replace it if maintainers want operation-gated delivery designed as a larger plugin API decision.

recommendation.title: Accept resolver and drain design
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility tradeoff as the intended fix and proceed after refreshing the branch against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the most recent same-surface contributor across the outbound resolver, delivery path, gateway send method, and QQBot channel files.
